question.text: A portfolio has SAA 70/30 equity/bond. Current actual is 76/24 (drift +6%). What action?

answer.text: Sell 6% of equity, buy 6% of bonds to restore 70/30

explanation.text: The Logic: Rebalance: trim winning sleeve (equity) and add to losing (bonds) to restore target. The Trap: Doing nothing lets drift compound. Cross-Exam Context: Core.
